segments.name: Senior secured loans
segments.description: Senior secured lending to private equity-owned U.S. middle market companies, mainly first-lien debt and unitranche loans.
segments.evidence: The Company is externally managed by Churchill and operates as a single reportable segment in accordance with ASC Topic 280, Segment Reporting ("ASC 280").

revenueModel.text: Borrowers pay the company floating-rate interest on directly originated senior secured loans to private equity-owned middle market companies.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's sole business activity is deriving investment income from its portfolio of investments.
